The master asks slave 1 to "Read Holding Registers": read 1 register starting from 40001

── Byte-by-byte ──
00 01  Transaction identifier  Sequence number 0x0001 assigned by the master to this exchange; the response echoes it
00 00  Protocol identifier     0x0000 = standard Modbus protocol
00 06  Length                  6 more bytes follow (unit identifier + data)
01     Unit identifier         slave address: device 1
03     Function code           0x03 = Read Holding Registers
00 00  Start address           protocol address 0, PLC address 40001
00 01  Read quantity           read 1 register

── Technical details ──
Transport: Modbus TCP (12 bytes total)
Transaction ID: 0x0001
Protocol ID: 0x0000
Length field: 6 (6 bytes actually follow)
Unit ID: 1
Function: 0x03 (Read Holding Registers)
Start address: 0 (PLC 40001)
Quantity: 1
PDU: 03 00 00 00 01
